## Checklist

- [ ] Read AGENTS.md and relevant specifications
- [ ] One scoped change; no duplicated infrastructure
- [ ] Licenses and dependency safety reviewed
- [ ] No secrets, private resumes, recordings or unauthorized datasets
- [ ] Unit/integration/E2E checks added or reason for omission recorded
- [ ] Do not label planned features as implemented
- [ ] Reviewer can reproduce evidence
